newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD Q1 net operational revenues up 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD Q1 net operational revenues up 11 pct.

text.p: The vice-president of soon-to-be-privatized Brazilian state mining giant CVRD said net operational revenues in the first quarter amounted to $693 million.
Anastacio Ubaldino Fernandes Filho said the January-to- March result represented an 11 percent increase on net operational revenue of $626 million in the first quarter of last year.
The company's complete first quarter results are expected to be announced next week.
All figures were calculated using Brazilian Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
